response.sql: WITH ratios AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_short_interest, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_option_volume_ratio, CASE WHEN AVG(sf.shortintrt) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AVG(sf.shortintrt) / (SELECT AVG(sf2.shortintrt) FROM transactionrecord tr2 JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf2 ON tr2.transreg = sf2.transref WHERE tr2.ordertypedist = tr.ordertypedist) END as short_interest_ratio FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON tr.transreg = sf.transref GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist) SELECT * FROM ratios ORDER BY CASE WHEN short_interest_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, short_interest_ratio DESC
